channel.title: KipFire tips
channel.description: Beginner guides for making videos on camera: content ideas, hooks and what to say.

item.title: What to Post When You Have No Ideas: 5 Quick Fixes
item.description: Stuck on what to post? 5 quick fixes for creative block: answer a question, react to something, share one small lesson, and film in 60 seconds.

item.title: Why Real Faces Still Win as AI Videos Fill Your Feed
item.description: AI videos are everywhere, but a real face and voice still build trust. Learn what only you can offer and simple steps to show your face, even if you're shy.

item.title: What to Say on Camera When Your Mind Goes Blank: 15 Easy Openers
item.description: Freeze the moment you hit record? Use these 15 simple first lines, a 3-part speaking formula, and real examples to talk on camera without a script.

item.title: How to Stop Being Scared of the Camera: 10 Small Steps
item.description: Scared to film yourself? Start small: record audio only, film without posting, use a prompt so you don't need ideas, and post a 15-second video first.

item.title: What Are Prompt Card Videos? How to Make One Today
item.description: Prompt card videos let you film without a script: pick a card, answer it on camera, post. Here is how they work, 15 card ideas and easy steps to start.

item.title: 100 Would You Rather Questions for Videos
item.description: 100 clean Would You Rather questions to film for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, plus 3 tips to make viewers answer in the comments.

item.title: How to Start Making Content on Camera: Ideas and What to Say
item.description: Never filmed yourself? Easy content ideas for beginners, what to say on camera in your first videos, and how to start with just your phone.
